column1: # Free-text origin/disease -> canonical organ (由来臓器).
# Rows are evaluated top to bottom and the FIRST case-insensitive substring hit
# wins.  That makes ordering load-bearing, and the hazard is a short pattern
# that happens to sit inside a longer term:
#   "bone"    inside "BONE marrow"    -> bone marrow must come first
# tests/test_pipeline.py pins every one of these; add a case there when you add
# a pattern that could be swallowed by another.
# Used only as a fallback when the input files do not carry an explicit
# organ/tissue column, and to refine the broad categories listed in
# Bare "intestine" only reaches here when nothing more specific matched.
# Ovary before "germ cell": ovarian germ cell tumours are not testicular.
